```python
from pydantic import BaseModel

class Reminder(BaseModel):
    user_id: int
    todo_id: int
    reminder_date: str
    enabled: bool

class NotificationResponse(BaseModel):
    message: str
```

Create a new file `app/notification/tests/test_schemas.py` with the following content:

```python
from app.notification.schemas import Reminder, NotificationResponse

def test_reminder_model():
    data = {
        "user_id": 1,
        "todo_id": 2,
        "reminder_date": "2023-10-01",
        "enabled": True
    }
    reminder = Reminder(**data)
    assert reminder.user_id == 1
    assert reminder.todo_id == 2
    assert reminder.reminder_date == "2023-10-01"
    assert reminder.enabled == True

def test_notification_response_model():
    data = {
        "message": "Reminder set successfully"
    }
    notification_response = NotificationResponse(**data)
    assert notification_response.message == "Reminder set successfully"
```
